[ソウル ２８日 ロイター] - 韓国外務省は２８日、北朝鮮兵捕虜の韓国への移送をウクライナ側が公表したことを受け、在韓国ウクライナ大使館のアンドリー・ベシキン代理大使を呼び出して抗議した。公式な説明と謝罪も求めた。両国間で非公表とするとの明確な合意があったと主張。ウクライナに対し、強い遺憾の意を表明したと述べた。

ゼレンスキー大統領は先週の国連総会の演説で、ロシア側として戦って捕虜となった北朝鮮兵２人を韓国に引き渡したと述べていた。韓国大統領府も２７日、ウクライナに対して公式な説明と謝罪を要求していた。

韓国外務省は、非公表とする合意はなかったとするウクライナ大統領府の説明についても「虚偽の声明」だとして抗議し、再発防止のための措置を講じるよう求めたと表明。

韓国メディアの報道によると、ベシキン氏は韓国の立場を正確に伝えると述べたという。

トランプ米大統領はこのところ、北朝鮮との対話への意欲を見せ、韓国も支持する考えを示している。

item.title: カタール仲介団、米・イランと個別協議へ 戦争終結目指す
item.description: [２８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２８日 ロイター] - カタールの仲介団が２８日か２９日に、ニューヨークでイランのアラグチ外相と、また別途米国側と協議する見通しだと、交渉について説明を受けた当局者がロイターに明らかにした。戦争終結に向けた新たな取り組みとなる。

匿名を条件に取材に応じた同当局者によると、協議では、イランが先週、国連総会に合わせて提示した７日間の計画の修正案が焦点となる見通し。

アラグチ氏は国連総会への出席後もニューヨークに滞在している。仲介団との協議に米国側から誰が出席するかは、現時点では不明。

イランの準国営ＩＳＮＡ通信はその後、アラグチ氏がニューヨーク時間２８日午前に米国で仲介団と会談すると確認した。双方は「現状に関する最新の提案や見解を検討する」という。

一方、イラン外務省のバガイ報道官は２８日、その後国営メディアに対し、アラグチ氏のニューヨーク滞在は延長されておらず、当初の予定通りテヘランに戻ると述べた。仲介団との協議についてはコメントしなかった。

＜トランプ氏、今週の追加協議を示唆＞

イランの７日間の計画は、イランとレバノンでの全ての敵対行為の停止、数十億ドル相当のイラン資産の凍結解除、イラン産原油に対する制裁の解除、米国によるイランの港湾封鎖の解除を想定している。

その上でイランはホルムズ海峡の再開を認め、米国とイランはイランの核開発計画を巡る協議も再開する。

トランプ米大統領は２６日、イランの提案を拒否したと表明。イランは深刻な経済的圧力にさらされているため、早期の合意を望んでいると述べた。

ただ、２７日には米ニュースサイトのアクシオスに対し、米交渉団が今週、さらなる協議に臨むとの見通しも示した。

item.title: Denmark send injured Dorgu back to Man United
item.description: Manchester United's Patrick Dorgu has been sent back from international duty after picking up an injury while playing for Denmark in their 2-0 win over Wales in the Nations League on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Manchester United's Patrick Dorgu has been sent back from international duty after picking up an injury while playing for Denmark in their 2-0 win over Wales in the Nations League on Sunday. The versatile 21-year-old, who can play as a left winger, left back or wing back, was forced off during the first half, appearing to hold the back of his thigh. “He has an injury and has to go home. A new one has to be called in," Denmark coach Brian Riemer told TV2. Dorgu has appeared in all five of United's Premier League games this season. He came on as a late substitute and assisted Matheus Cunha's equaliser as United drew [USN:L1N45C055 TEXT:"1-1 at Fulham"] in their last game before the international break.

item.title: India's market regulator disposes of proceedings against Adani Group companies on public-float violations
item.description: India's market regulator on Monday disposed of proceedings against Adani Group Chairman Gautam Adani and four group companies in a case regarding public-float violations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: India's market regulator on Monday disposed of proceedings against Adani Group Chairman Gautam Adani and four group companies in a case regarding public-float violations. The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) imposed penalties of 2 million rupees ($20,837.13) each on two individuals in the case for wrongful disclosures. ($1 = 95.9825 Indian rupees)

item.title: Meta contrata presidente da MongoDB para impulsionar iniciativa de IA corporativa
item.description: A Meta contratou o presidente-executivo da MongoDB , Chirantan “CJ” Desai, para liderar um novo negócio destinado a levar as ferramentas de inteligência artificial da companhia de mídia social a clientes corporativos.
item.dc:creator: Harshita Varghese
item.content:encoded: A Meta (META.O) contratou o presidente-executivo da MongoDB (MDB.O) , Chirantan “CJ” Desai, para liderar um novo negócio destinado a levar as ferramentas de inteligência artificial da companhia de mídia social a clientes corporativos. As ações da fornecedora de software de banco de dados despencaram 18% nesta segunda-feira, já que Desai está deixando o cargo após menos de um ano como presidente-executivo. Desai, um executivo veterano da área de tecnologia, assumiu o cargo no lugar de Dev Ittycheria. A MongoDB nomeou Ittycheria como presidente-executivo interino enquanto procura um substituto permanente. “Embora a saída seja decepcionante, acreditamos que a MongoDB continua bem posicionada estrategicamente e consideramos a reação do preço das ações exagerada”, afirmou a corretora Piper Sandler em uma nota. A Meta anunciou nesta segunda-feira que levará seus modelos de IA, agentes e ferramentas para as empresas por meio da nova Meta Enterprise Platform, incluindo o recém-lançado Muse, o Meta Business Agent e ferramentas de programação. A empresa lançou o Muse no início deste mês, um agente pessoal de IA projetado para realizar tarefas como fazer compras, reservar viagens, enviar emails e efetuar pagamentos em nome dos usuários. O Muse subiu rapidamente nos rankings da App Store da Apple e do Google Play nas últimas semanas e foi descrito por analistas como potencialmente o maior lançamento de aplicativo nos EUA desde o ChatGPT, em novembro de 2022, que ajudou a dar início ao boom da IA. Desai se reportará diretamente ao presidente-executivo da Meta, Mark Zuckerberg, no cargo recém-criado de diretor de plataforma empresarial, e se concentrará em transformar a IA da companhia em produtos e serviços que as empresas possam implantar em seus próprios negócios. Antes de ingressar na MongoDB, Desai liderou as áreas de produto e engenharia na Cloudflare (NET.N) e passou quase oito anos na ServiceNow (NOW.N) , inclusive como presidente e diretor de operações. A MongoDB fornece software de banco de dados utilizado por empresas para desenvolver e executar aplicativos, com ferramentas para gerenciamento de dados, pesquisa, análise e IA.

item.title: Boston sues Trump administration after grant nixed over EV support
item.description: The city of Boston sued on Monday to challenge the Trump administration's rescission of a $20 million federal grant for a streets improvement project, citing plans to install electric vehicle charging stations as a reason for the cancellation.
item.dc:creator: Nate Raymond
item.content:encoded: The city of Boston sued on Monday to challenge the Trump administration's rescission of a $20 million federal grant for a streets improvement project, citing plans to install electric vehicle charging stations as a reason for the cancellation. The lawsuit, filed in federal court in Massachusetts, says the charging stations represented less than 1% of the project's cost and that the city offered to remove them, but the department refused to restore the funding. The lawsuit is the second by a city challenging the US Department of Transportation's cancellation of grants, [USN:L1N2SA092 TEXT:"issued under a program"] called Rebuilding American Infrastructure with Sustainability and Equity (RAISE). The program was funded through the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act, former Democratic President Joe Biden's signature 2021 law to address climate change. The Department of Transportation in a statement on Monday said it is reviewing the lawsuit and "remains committed to ensuring that taxpayer dollars are spent wisely and in ways that benefit all Americans." The department in September 2025 terminated several RAISE grants that had funded projects nationwide, including pedestrian safety improvements, bike lanes and other transportation upgrades. Boston received its $20 million grant in 2022 for a nearly $34 million project to redesign three heavily traveled streets in the populous neighborhood of Roxbury. The project included roadway repairs, wider sidewalks and measures to speed bus service for commuters. "Boston earned this competitive grant to meet community needs and address long-needed infrastructure upgrades," Boston Mayor Michelle Wu, a Democrat, said in a statement. But the department under Trump withdrew the funding, saying the grant was "inconsistent" with its priorities because it would involve installing EV charging stations. The Trump administration has [USN:L1N3YO15Q TEXT:"pursued a series of policies"] aimed at boosting the sale of gas-powered vehicles and cutting EV incentives for automakers and consumers. Represented in part by the Public Rights Project, Boston argues the department lacked legal authority to cancel the grant on that basis and that it violated the Administrative Procedure Act and constitutional separation-of-powers principles by doing so. It says Congress did not authorize the department to rescind grants due to the inclusion of EV infrastructure and that underlying statutory criteria for the program prioritized projects that would improve environmental sustainability. The city of Albuquerque, New Mexico, last year filed a similar lawsuit, after the Department of Transportation withdrew an $11.5 million grant to support an urban trail project in the city's downtown. The department did so saying the project ran counter to its focus on promoting "vehicular travel." The lawsuit remains pending after recently surviving a motion to dismiss. The case is City of Boston v. Duffy et al, US District Court for the District of Massachusetts, No. 1:26-cv-14419. For Boston: Megan Corrigan of the City of Boston Law Department and Cassandra Crawford of the Public Rights Project Read more: [USN:L1N3YO15Q TEXT:"Trump administration unlawfully suspended EV charger infrastructure program, US judge rules"]

item.title: Russia says it hit cargo vessels bound for Ukraine, telecoms infrastructure in Kyiv
item.description: Russia's Defence Ministry said on Monday its forces had struck fuel and telecommunications infrastructure in Kyiv, as well as several cargo vessels that it alleged were supplying the Ukrainian military.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Russia's Defence Ministry said on Monday its forces had struck fuel and telecommunications infrastructure in Kyiv, as well as several cargo vessels that it alleged were supplying the Ukrainian military. The ministry said the Russian strikes hit three cargo vessels bound for Odesa and another cargo vessel in the port of Chornomorsk. A ship repair facility in the port of Izmail was also struck, it added. The ministry said several data centres in Kyiv were hit in overnight and daytime attacks. Reuters could not independently verify the ministry's reports.

item.title: Oil stocks in US strategic petroleum reserve fall to lowest level since 1982
item.description: Stocks of crude oil in the U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve fell to 283.8 million barrels last week, the lowest level since October 1982, according to data from the Department of Energy.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Stocks of crude oil in the U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve fell to 283.8 million barrels last week, the lowest level since October 1982, according to data from the Department of Energy. The drawdowns are part of a U.S. agreement to release 172 million barrels from the facility.

item.title: Ballroom donors will dance like someone's watching
item.description: Companies that have been cozy with President Trump, including by funding his $400 mln gilded event space, have started to squirm. Many, from Amazon to Kirkland & Ellis, are likely to face painful scrutiny if Democrats win the House in November. Capitol heat tends to fry CEOs.
item.dc:creator: Gabriel Rubin
item.content:encoded: Business titans [USN:L6N45G1DV TEXT:"toasted"] Chinese President Xi Jinping in Washington last week, and some will probably be back soon to be roasted. Democrats, giddy about November’s midterm elections, plan to use their congressional mantles to probe companies that have been cozy with the Trump administration. The oversight will be an onerous and costly distraction, and Capitol Hill has been the end of the line for many CEOs. With President Donald Trump’s approval rating languishing in the low 30% range, Republicans are already warning Corporate America about ballot-box repercussions. Investigative targets would include companies that contributed funds to the commander-in-chief's $400 million ballroom project and ones that had business dealings with his family. Representative Jamie Raskin , who is in line to run the House Judiciary Committee if Democrats win the chamber in November, has flagged what he calls systems of bribery, kickbacks and financial corruption. E-commerce powerhouse Amazon (AMZN.O) , cable operator Comcast (CMCSA.O) and software goliath Microsoft (MSFT.O) are among the publicly named corporate donors to Trump's White House renovation project already scrambling to explain themselves. Law firms that struck deals with the Oval Office to preserve security clearances and government contracts or which have otherwise advised the administration, including Kirkland & Ellis, also would be in the political crossfire. The AI, defense , semiconductor, mining and energy industries may be scrutinized for federal grant and loan money they received. Complying with such investigations is often time-consuming and expensive, even before subpoenas arrive. Document requests, internal audits and retention of crisis-PR teams and outside legal counsel all suck up valuable resources. Even highly coached bosses falter in the glare, too. Wells Fargo (WFC.N) CEO John Stumpf stepped down a decade ago soon after he endured two congressional grillings over a fake-accounts scandal at the mega-bank. Boeing's (BA.N) Dave Calhoun told Congress in 2024 he would see through a safety crisis after one Republican senator asked why he was still in his job; he was gone by the end of the year. Mark Zuckerberg has greater job security by virtue of his voting control over $1.8 trillion Meta Platforms, but his 2018 hearing before Senate Judiciary, Commerce and Energy committees marked a turning point in the debate over self-policing social media. When US government power is divided, and legislative prospects bleakest, such inquiries get a lot of attention. Rather than try and impeach a president who cannot run again, political capital will be devoted instead to examining those companies and individuals perceived to have engaged in and enabled wrongdoing. Captains of industry and their shareholders should be braced to pay a price. Follow Gabriel Rubin on Bluesky and LinkedIn . House Democrats preparing for a possible return to power after the US November midterm elections are developing a broad investigative strategy targeting companies that have had dealings with President Donald Trump. CONTEXT-NEWS

item.title: El BCE estudia nuevas medidas de protección monetaria para reforzar el papel del euro
item.description: El Banco Central Europeo tiene previsto ampliar las redes de seguridad monetarias para facilitar a los bancos centrales extranjeros la obtención de préstamos en euros, dijo el lunes la presidenta del BCE, Christine Lagarde, en un intento por reforzar la posición global de la moneda única.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Banco Central Europeo tiene previsto ampliar las redes de seguridad monetarias para facilitar a los bancos centrales extranjeros la obtención de préstamos en euros, dijo el lunes la presidenta del BCE, Christine Lagarde, en un intento por reforzar la posición global de la moneda única. La iniciativa surge en un contexto de preocupación por la fragmentación financiera y la creciente incertidumbre en torno al futuro del dólar estadounidense bajo el mandato del presidente Donald Trump. Lagarde señaló que el BCE trabajará en las líneas de swap, que actúan como fuente de liquidez de emergencia en momentos de crisis al permitir a los bancos centrales extranjeros obtener préstamos en euros a cambio de su propia moneda. "Trabajaremos en líneas de swap que respondan mejor a la necesidad imperiosa de contar con una zona del euro soberana y un euro fuerte", dijo Lagarde a legisladores europeos. Las líneas de swap alivian la presión sobre los prestatarios extranjeros, pero también evitan que la tensión en el extranjero se extienda a la zona del euro. El BCE mantiene acuerdos de este tipo con la Reserva Federal de Estados Unidos y con los bancos centrales de Japón, el Reino Unido, Canadá y Suiza. La medida forma parte del esfuerzo continuo del BCE por ampliar la presencia internacional del euro. El BCE ha recibido cerca de 30 solicitudes para una línea de crédito independiente —conocida como acuerdos de recompra o "repo"— que permite a los bancos extranjeros obtener préstamos a cambio de garantías en euros. A los responsables de los bancos centrales y a los inversionistas les preocupa que la Reserva Federal de Estados Unidos pueda acabar recortando sus propias líneas de swap, que actualmente constituyen el principal salvavidas global para billones de dólares en préstamos extranjeros.

item.title: Dinamarca prevé una presencia a largo plazo de la OTAN en Groenlandia tras acuerdo con Trump
item.description: Dinamarca confía en que la OTAN mantenga una presencia reforzada en Groenlandia y en toda la región ártica por un largo tiempo, tras el acuerdo de seguridad firmado la semana pasada con Estados Unidos, dijo el lunes el ministro de Defensa danés.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Gray
item.content:encoded: Dinamarca confía en que la OTAN mantenga una presencia reforzada en Groenlandia y en toda la región ártica por un largo tiempo, tras el acuerdo de seguridad firmado la semana pasada con Estados Unidos, dijo el lunes el ministro de Defensa danés. La OTAN puso en marcha a principios de este año una misión denominada "Arctic Sentry" para intensificar los ejercicios y las patrullas en la región, como parte de un esfuerzo por calmar la fuerte tensión dentro de la alianza militar a raíz de la intención del presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, de adquirir Groenlandia. En una entrevista con Reuters en Bruselas, el ministro de Defensa danés, Jeppe Bruus, dijo que Copenhague esperaba que "Arctic Sentry" continue después de este año y del próximo para convertirse en una misión permanente. Cuando se le preguntó si había recibido señales claras de los aliados de la OTAN de que están interesados, Bruus respondió: "Hasta ahora estamos bastante seguros de que la mayor presencia militar en Groenlandia —pero también en el Ártico— continuará". El acuerdo, firmado por Trump y los líderes de Dinamarca y Groenlandia en las Naciones Unidas la semana pasada, prevé que Estados Unidos añada dos bases más a la que ya tiene en el territorio ártico danés semiautónomo. Pero también considera un papel más importante para la OTAN. Bruus señaló que dicho papel sería importante, ya que el deshielo provocado por el cambio climático abre nuevas rutas marítimas en el Ártico. "El creciente interés por el Ártico, también por parte de Rusia, China y otros, exige que la OTAN tenga una mayor presencia en el Alto Norte", agregó.

item.title: Trump's AI meeting with tech CEOs to focus on finding balance, US House speaker says
item.description: President Donald Trump's meeting with tech CEOs on artificial intelligence on Tuesday will focus on finding a balance between innovation and oversight, House Speaker Mike Johnson said, as the federal government seeks to define its role in the burgeoning technology.
item.dc:creator: Katharine Jackson
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump's meeting with tech CEOs on artificial intelligence on Tuesday will focus on finding a balance between innovation and oversight, House Speaker Mike Johnson said, as the federal government seeks to define its role in the burgeoning technology. "We do not need a moratorium. We do not need to jump in and hyper-regulate this, because we'll lose the race to China," Johnson said in an interview on Monday with Fox Business Network. "The innovation is important to continue, but we have to strike the right balance. That's what the conversation is going to be about." The White House meeting, which will include Johnson, comes as leading AI companies are calling for slowing development of increasingly capable AI systems, warning of the risks to humanity and appealing for governments to work together to manage the increasingly powerful technology. Trump has downplayed concerns over the misuse of artificial intelligence harming people as he stressed the importance of maintaining America's competitive edge over China. He says the US already has [USN:L6N45E0R5 TEXT:"guardrails in place"] for the powerful technology, including at the Department of Justice. Johnson said the US should be mindful of safety but not stymie the technology's development. "I think there may be a role for the DOJ if things go awry. But what we need before we get to that stage is transparency, and we need some oversight," he said on "Mornings with Fox Business." [USN:L6N4520JA TEXT:"Lawmakers"] in both parties have questioned Trump's hands-off approach even as the technology raises fears about safety, job losses and the concentration of power among a handful of tech companies. House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries said AI industry leaders were pleading for some government action and Congress has a responsibility to protect the American people. "So, when it comes to AI safety, it certainly seems to me that we need to actually lean in boldly and responsibly — now," Jeffries told CNBC on Monday. The president had dinner with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei on Sunday. Anthropic and its rivals have called for slowing AI development. These include OpenAI, Google’s (GOOGL.O) DeepMind, Microsoft (MSFT.O) and xAI.

item.title: Lagarde für "maßvolle" Reaktion auf Inflation - Zinsschritt im Dezember?
item.description: Die EZB will laut ihrer Präsidentin Christine Lagarde mit Augenmaß auf die vom Iran-Krieg angeheizte Inflation reagieren. Diese bewege sich auf einem "mittleren" Pfad, der von der Europäischen Zentralbank lediglich maßvolle Zinserhöhungen erfordere, betonte sie am Montag bei einer Anhörung vor einem Ausschuss des Europäischen Parlaments. Die EZB erwarte zwar eine höhere Inflation, sehe aber bislang keine Anzeichen dafür, dass sie sich verfestige: "Zum jetzigen Zeitpunkt sehen wir keine Belege dafür, dass sich die Energiepreise auf die Löhne übertragen." Mit den Äußerungen wurden Zinsfantasien an den Finanzmärkten gedämpft. Dort gilt eine Erhöhung auf der EZB-Ratssitzung Ende Oktober als weniger wahrscheinlich. Eine Zinsanhebung im Dezember ist hingegen eingepreist.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die EZB will laut ihrer Präsidentin Christine Lagarde mit Augenmaß auf die vom Iran-Krieg angeheizte Inflation reagieren. Diese bewege sich auf einem "mittleren" Pfad, der von der Europäischen Zentralbank lediglich maßvolle Zinserhöhungen erfordere, betonte sie am Montag bei einer Anhörung vor einem Ausschuss des Europäischen Parlaments. Die EZB erwarte zwar eine höhere Inflation, sehe aber bislang keine Anzeichen dafür, dass sie sich verfestige: "Zum jetzigen Zeitpunkt sehen wir keine Belege dafür, dass sich die Energiepreise auf die Löhne übertragen." Mit den Äußerungen wurden Zinsfantasien an den Finanzmärkten gedämpft. Dort gilt eine Erhöhung auf der EZB-Ratssitzung Ende Oktober als weniger wahrscheinlich. Eine Zinsanhebung im Dezember ist hingegen eingepreist. Lagarde bekräftigte vor dem Ausschuss, dass sich die Zinsen "nicht im Gleichschritt" mit den Energiepreisen bewegten. Die [USN:L8N4590LJ TEXT:"Inflationsrate"] ist im August im Euroraum auf 3,2 Prozent gestiegen und liegt damit deutlich über dem Zielwert der EZB von 2,0 Prozent. Energie erwies sich dabei als Preistreiber Nummer eins: Sie verteuerte sich um 14,3 Prozent zum Vorjahresmonat. INFLATION AUF DEM VORMARSCH Für September halten Volkswirte ein weiteres Anziehen der Teuerungsrate im Euroraum auf 3,6 Prozent für möglich. Wegen des Iran-Krieges und der damit verbundenen höheren Benzin- und Gaspreise rechnen manche Experten bis zum Jahresende sogar mit einem Anstieg auf vier Prozent. Die führenden Wirtschaftsforschungsinstitute erwarten in ihrem [USN:L8N45G0CS TEXT:"Herbstgutachten"], dass es Ende des Jahres einen weiteren Zinsschritt der EZB nach oben geben wird. Bei einer Erhöhung um einen Viertelpunkt dürfte der für die Geldpolitik relevante Einlagensatz dann bei 2,75  Prozent liegen. Die EZB hatte den Leitzins im Kampf gegen die vom Ölpreisschock infolge des Iran-Krieges angeheizte Inflation im September zum zweiten Mal in diesem Jahr angehoben.

item.title: Florida solicita a corte prohibición de nuevos modelos de OpenAI en demanda por daños a menores
item.description: El fiscal general de Florida solicitó el lunes a un juez que impida a OpenAI desarrollar nuevos modelos de inteligencia artificial sin supervisión externa, en el marco de una demanda en la que se acusa a la empresa de causar daño a los menores.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El fiscal general de Florida solicitó el lunes a un juez que impida a OpenAI desarrollar nuevos modelos de inteligencia artificial sin supervisión externa, en el marco de una demanda en la que se acusa a la empresa de causar daño a los menores. Florida demandó a OpenAI en junio acusando a la empresa de falsear la seguridad de su plataforma ChatGPT, alegando que ha perjudicado a los niños al proporcionar información a autores de tiroteos en colegios, ofrecer orientación sobre autolesiones y crear adicción entre los usuarios jóvenes. El fiscal general de Florida, James Uthmeier, solicitó también en el escrito presentado el lunes que el tribunal ordene a OpenAI impedir el acceso de menores a ChatGPT y prohíba a la empresa dotar a su plataforma de chat de "atributos humanos". Un portavoz de OpenAI no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios.

item.title: Países da UE aprovam cinco grandes projetos pan-europeus de defesa
item.description: Os países-membros da União Europeia aprovaram nesta segunda-feira planos para cinco projetos pan-europeus de defesa que abrangem medidas de defesa espacial, marítima, aérea e contra drones, os quais agora serão elegíveis para financiamento da UE.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os países-membros da União Europeia aprovaram nesta segunda-feira planos para cinco projetos pan-europeus de defesa que abrangem medidas de defesa espacial, marítima, aérea e contra drones, os quais agora serão elegíveis para financiamento da UE. Os Projetos Europeus de Defesa de Interesse Comum (EDPCIs) permitem que os países europeus trabalhem em conjunto em grandes iniciativas de defesa que seriam grandes ou complexas demais para serem desenvolvidas por um único Estado da UE, informou o Conselho da União Europeia em comunicado anunciando as aprovações. Os cinco projetos que receberam aprovação para financiamento concentram-se no desenvolvimento de táticas de combate a drones e de defesa contra drones, bem como na proteção do flanco oriental da Europa. Originalmente propostos pela Comissão Europeia em julho, eles também incluem um projeto integrado de defesa marítima e do leito marinho, um projeto de defesa aérea e antimísseis e de alerta antecipado e um projeto de defesa espacial. “Trabalhando em estreita colaboração com nossos parceiros, a Noruega e a Ucrânia, juntos estamos tomando medidas decisivas para proteger o espaço, nossos céus, nossos mares, os cabos submarinos e nossos cidadãos que dependem deles”, afirmou Helen McEntee, ministra da Defesa da Irlanda — que detém a presidência rotativa do Conselho —, em um comunicado. No âmbito do Programa Europeu da Indústria de Defesa do bloco, um orçamento de 325 milhões de euros (US$370 milhões) está destinado às EDPCIs, com a possibilidade de mais recursos serem disponibilizados no futuro. (Reportagem de Mateusz Rabiega)

item.title: Polonia levante advertencia de buscar refugio tras ataques de Rusia contra Ucrania
item.description: El Centro de Seguridad del Gobierno de Polonia levantó el lunes una advertencia que había emitido minutos antes en que alertaba a los residentes de la región oriental de Lublin que buscaran un lugar seguro debido a los ataques rusos contra la vecina Ucrania.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Centro de Seguridad del Gobierno de Polonia levantó el lunes una advertencia que había emitido minutos antes en que alertaba a los residentes de la región oriental de Lublin que buscaran un lugar seguro debido a los ataques rusos contra la vecina Ucrania. "ATENCIÓN!. La amenaza de ataque aéreo ha sido levantada. No hay una amenaza dentro del territorio de Polonia", aseguró el centro. Anteriormente había anunciado que aviones polacos estaban operando en el espacio aéreo del país como consecuencia de los ataques rusos contra Ucrania.

item.title: Report: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane (ACL) out for season
item.description: Miami Dolphins running back De'Von Achane will miss the rest of the season after tearing his left ACL in Sunday's loss to Kansas City, ESPN reported Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Miami Dolphins running back De'Von Achane will miss the rest of the season after tearing his left ACL in Sunday's loss to Kansas City, ESPN reported Monday. Achane, 24, sustained the knee injury on his third rushing attempt in the 24-10 setback against the Chiefs in Miami Gardens, Fla. He hobbled off the field after being tackled awkwardly by safety Alohi Gilman. "To be very honest with you, it does not sound very optimistic at this moment, but I can't give you any other details until I have them," Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley said after the game. Achane finished with 17 yards rushing on three carries, and no receptions on one target. For the season, he has rushed for 127 yards on 34 attempts with no touchdowns in three games. He has seven catches for 49 yards and no scores. Second-year pro Ollie Gordon replaced Achane as the lead back for the Dolphins (0-3) and rushed for 41 yards and a touchdown on 17 carries. Achane posted career highs with 1,350 rushing yards and 1,838 yards from scrimmage and made his first Pro Bowl last season. A third-round pick by Miami in 2023, he has 4,510 yards from scrimmage and 35 touchdowns through 47 career games (39 starts). --Field Level Media

item.title: Buttler ruled out of Pakistan Tri-series with hamstring injury
item.description: Jos Buttler will miss England's one-day international Tri-series in Pakistan next month after suffering a hamstring injury against Sri Lanka last week, limited-overs coach Brendon McCullum said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Jos Buttler will miss England's one-day international Tri-series in Pakistan next month after suffering a hamstring injury against Sri Lanka last week, limited-overs coach Brendon McCullum said on Monday. The former England captain pulled up while batting during England's 16-run defeat at Headingley on Thursday. He initially retired hurt before returning to the crease later in the innings. The 36-year-old was replaced by Jordan Cox for Sunday's third ODI at The Oval, where Cox scored 76 in England's 223-run win. "Jos won't be in Pakistan," McCullum told reporters. "We know he's an incredible athlete, supremely fit and an ultra-professional, so he'll do everything he can to get back as soon as possible. But it's hard to judge how long that will be." England travel to Pakistan for a Tri-series involving the hosts and Sri Lanka beginning on October 18. The side will head to Australia in November for three ODIs and five Twenty20 internationals. McCullum said Buttler's absence offered an opportunity to test England's depth ahead of next year's 50-over World Cup. "It's disappointing not to have Jos, but it will be good for us to see where we're at," he said. "Between now and 14 months' time, lots of things will go wrong. There'll be selections you think will happen and then someone will get injured, or there'll be a scheduling issue. You almost have to catastrophise these things a little to prepare yourself for that World Cup." Next year's World Cup will be played in South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia starting on October 4.

item.title: Poland lifts warning to take shelter following Russia strikes on Ukraine
item.description: Poland's Government Centre for Security on Monday lifted a warning it had issued minutes earlier that had told people in the eastern Lublin region to take shelter due to Russian air strikes on neighbouring Ukraine.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Poland's Government Centre for Security on Monday lifted a warning it had issued minutes earlier that had told people in the eastern Lublin region to take shelter due to Russian air strikes on neighbouring Ukraine. "ATTENTION! The air attack threat has been lifted. There is no threat within the territory of Poland," the centre said. It had earlier said Polish jets were operating in Polish airspace as a result of Russian strikes on Ukraine.

item.title: Workers at Antofagasta's Centinela mine reject offer, pave way for strike
item.description: Workers from two unions at Antofagasta Minerals' Centinela copper mine in northern Chile rejected on Monday the company's collective contract offer, paving the way for a strike.
item.dc:creator: Fabian Cambero
item.content:encoded: Workers from two unions at Antofagasta Minerals' (ANTO.L) Centinela copper mine in northern Chile rejected on Monday the company's collective contract offer, paving the way for a strike. The company and unions must now undergo a mandatory five-day government-led mediation process, which can be extended for another five days by mutual agreement, before a strike can legally begin 98.73% of unions members voted in favor of a strike, with all eligible members participating in the vote The Minera Esperanza and Distrito Centinela unions had urged their members to reject the offer, complaining that Antofagasta Minerals has refused to discuss equalizing benefits for workers regardless of union affiliation Antofagasta Minerals does not comment on its collective bargaining negotiations Centinela produced 240,400 metric tons of copper in 2025

item.title: Fed, watchdog interno segnala possibile fuga di informazioni da dipendente
item.description: L'organismo di controllo interno della Federal Reserve ha emesso un avviso in cui segnala un dipendente che potrebbe aver lasciato la banca centrale portando con sé informazioni riservate.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L'organismo di controllo interno della Federal Reserve ha emesso un avviso in cui segnala un dipendente che potrebbe aver lasciato la banca centrale portando con sé informazioni riservate. "Questo avviso riguarda un dipendente del Board in uscita che potrebbe aver sottratto informazioni classificate del Federal Open Market Committee (Fomc) e altre informazioni sensibili", dopo essere stato coinvolto in precedenza in "un incidente di sicurezza informatica" relativo a informazioni del Fomc, ha affermato l'Ispettore generale della Fed. "Questo potenziale episodio mette in luce i rischi per la sicurezza delle informazioni, nonché carenze e falle nei controlli che, a nostro avviso, richiedono l’immediata attenzione del Board", ha sottolineato l’organismo di controllo.

item.title: Usa e Iran pronti a colloqui separati con mediatori oggi o domani - fonte
item.description: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sulla situazione in Medio Oriente:
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sulla situazione in Medio Oriente: 16.10 - I mediatori del Qatar dovrebbero tenere colloqui con il ministro degli Esteri iraniano Abbas Araqchi a New York e, separatamente, con la parte statunitense oggi o domani. Lo ha riferito a Reuters una fonte informata sui negoziati, nel quadro di un nuovo tentativo di porre fine alla guerra. 15.40 - Il ministro degli Esteri iraniano Abbas Araqchi incontrerà i mediatori oggi a New York Lo ha detto l'agenzia iraniana Isna. Secondo quanto riferito in precedenza da un funzionario informato sui negoziati, i colloqui con i mediatori del Qatar dovrebbero concentrarsi su una versione modificata della proposta di sette giorni presentata dall'Iran la scorsa settimana a margine dell'Assemblea generale delle Nazioni Unite. 13.00 - Teheran ha respinto le forze nemiche dalle acque al largo dell'Iran meridionale fino al Mar Arabico. Lo ha comunicato la Guida Suprema Mojtaba Khamenei sul proprio canale Telegram, avvertendo che l'Iran le costringerà presto a ritirarsi anche oltre il Mar Arabico. 8.45 - L'alta rappresentante dell'Unione europea per gli Affari esteri, Kaja Kallas, ha detto che la missione Aspides, avviata per proteggere le navi nel Mar Rosso, necessita di un maggior numero di unità navali per diventare pienamente operativa. Intervenendo all'arrivo alla riunione dei ministri della Difesa dell'Ue a Bruxelles, Kallas ha detto di aver esortato gli Stati membri a contribuire maggiormente alla missione, senza tuttavia avere ricevuto finora nuovi impegni concreti. 7.40 - Il ministro degli Esteri saudita, il principe Faisal bin Farhan, è arrivato a Washington per un incontro con il segretario di Stato Usa Marco Rubio. Lo ha riferito l'agenzia di stampa ufficiale saudita, mentre si intensificano le ostilità tra Riyadh e gli Houthi yemeniti. Questo mese il principe ereditario saudita Mohammed bin Salman aveva chiesto agli Stati Uniti un sostegno militare contro gli Houthi, sostenuti dall'Iran, ma Washington aveva respinto l'ipotesi di condurre attacchi diretti, accettando tuttavia di fornire supporto in termini di intelligence e identificazione degli obiettivi, secondo quanto riferito da fonti a Reuters. 7.00 - L'Iran ha ribadito domenica che solo la diplomazia può risolvere il conflitto con gli Stati Uniti e Israele, dopo che il presidente statunitense Donald Trump ha affermato di aver respinto una proposta iraniana volta a riaprire lo Stretto di Hormuz e a porre fine ai combattimenti.

item.title: Bridgepoint, Astorg consider £2 billion-plus Fenergo sale, sources say
item.description: Bridgepoint and Astorg are considering selling Fenergo as dealmaking in the sector picks up, three people familiar with the matter said, with one saying the Irish fintech could be valued at more than £2 billion ($2.7 billion).
item.dc:creator: Amy-Jo Crowley
item.content:encoded: Bridgepoint (BPTB.L) and Astorg are considering selling Fenergo as dealmaking in the sector picks up, three people familiar with the matter said, with one saying the Irish fintech could be valued at more than £2 billion ($2.7 billion). The private equity firms have held discussions with potential buyers and are expected to appoint an investment bank later this year in a potential transaction that could attract strategic bidders, the sources told Reuters. A sales process could be launched early in 2027, with a decision yet to be taken, said two of the sources. Bridgepoint and Astorg both declined to comment. Dublin-based Fenergo did not respond to a request for comment. Fenergo develops software that helps more than 300 of the world's largest banks and insurers comply with regulatory requirements and manage client lifecycle processes, including onboarding, know-your-customer checks and data management. The potential deal highlights [USN:L6N45F0TW TEXT:"a pickup"] in tech dealmaking despite a selloff in software stocks earlier this year. [USN:L6N44U168 TEXT:"Thoma Bravo"] is exploring a sale of Foundation Software, Vista Equity Partners is considering selling banking software provider Finastra and healthcare software company Waystar is weighing its options, Reuters reported earlier this month. Fenergo, founded and led by CEO Mark Murphy, is expected to attract interest from information services companies and exchange operators, the sources said. Astorg and Bridgepoint acquired Fenergo from Insight Partners in 2021 for an undisclosed sum. The company has also sought to capitalise on demand for AI tools, launching an agentic AI orchestration platform designed to automate workflows such as onboarding and periodic reviews. Its total revenue rose by 7.5% to €149.4 million ($170 million) for the year ending in March 2025, driven by more subscription revenue and client renewals for its software products. Operating profit increased 66% to €20.9 million. ($1 = 0.7539 pounds) ($1 = 0.8799 euros)

item.title: Insider: Evonik zeigt BASF die kalte Schulter - Offerte zu niedrig
item.description: Der Spezialchemiekonzern Evonik hat Insidern zufolge ein Übernahmeangebot des größeren Rivalen BASF abgewiesen. Die Offerte sei als zu niedrig angesehen worden, sagten zwei mit dem Vorgang vertraute Personen am Montag der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters. BASF habe rund 22,15 Euro je Evonik-Aktie geboten. Das Angebot entspricht einem Aufschlag von gut 28 Prozent auf den Evonik-Aktienkurs vor dem Bekanntwerden erster Übernahmespekulationen in der vergangenen Woche. Das Essener Unternehmen wird damit inklusive Schulden mit rund 14 Milliarden Euro bewertet. Evonik lehnte eine Stellungnahme ab.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Der Spezialchemiekonzern Evonik (EVKn.DE) hat Insidern zufolge ein Übernahmeangebot des größeren Rivalen BASF (BASFn.DE) abgewiesen. Die Offerte sei als zu niedrig angesehen worden, sagten zwei mit dem Vorgang vertraute Personen am Montag der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters. BASF habe rund 22,15 Euro je Evonik-Aktie geboten. Das Angebot entspricht einem Aufschlag von gut 28 Prozent auf den Evonik-Aktienkurs vor dem Bekanntwerden erster Übernahmespekulationen in der vergangenen Woche. Das Essener Unternehmen wird damit inklusive Schulden mit rund 14 Milliarden Euro bewertet. Evonik lehnte eine Stellungnahme ab. BASF wollte sich zu dem genannten Preis nicht äußern. Der Konzern teilte jedoch mit, eine mögliche Übernahme würde die eigenen Kerngeschäfte stärken und ergänzen. Dabei verfolge das Unternehmen einen disziplinierten Ansatz: "Unsere Bewertung basiert auf einem Synergiepotenzial, das nur unter Einbindung von Evonik verifiziert werden kann." Evonik-Aktien stiegen am Montag um bis zu 2,5 Prozent auf 19,85 Euro. Beide Unternehmen hatten [USN:L8N45H10Q TEXT:"am Freitag"] Sondierungsgespräche bestätigt. Für BASF wäre eine Übernahme von Evonik einer der größten Zukäufe in der gut 160-jährigen Firmengeschichte. Die bislang größten Übernahmen der Ludwigshafener waren der Erwerb der Saatgut- und Herbizidgeschäfte von Bayer (BAYGn.DE) im Jahr 2018 für 7,6 Milliarden Euro sowie der Kauf des US-Katalysatorherstellers Engelhard 2006 für 4,8 Milliarden Dollar. Eine Schlüsselrolle bei einem möglichen Zusammenschluss fällt der RAG-Stiftung zu, die 43 Prozent an Evonik hält. Im Kuratorium der Stiftung ist das Land Nordrhein-Westfalen durch Ministerpräsident Hendrik Wüst vertreten. Das Düsseldorfer Wirtschaftsministerium verfolge das Übernahmeinteresse sehr aufmerksam, erklärte Wirtschaftsministerin Mona Neubaur am Montag. "Jede Lösung muss sich daran messen lassen, ob sie den Investitionen an den Standorten in Nordrhein-Westfalen und den Menschen, die dort arbeiten, eine Zukunft gäbe", sagte sie. Die Stiftung selbst wollte sich zu der Offerte nicht äußern. Der Vorsitzende der Gewerkschaft IG BCE, Michael Vassiliadis, der sowohl im Kuratorium der RAG-Stiftung als auch im Aufsichtsrat von BASF sitzt, sieht bei einer möglichen Übernahme viele offene Fragen. Ein Kauf eines erfolgreichen Unternehmens durch ein anderes werde für Standorte und Beschäftigte nicht allein dadurch zu einer Zukunftsgeschichte, dass das neue Gebilde größer werde, [USN:L8N45K0ZF TEXT:"sagte er"] am Montag. Für die Beschäftigten beider Konzerne müsse es Zukunftsperspektiven und Investitionszusagen geben.

item.title: ECB eyes new currency safety nets to boost euro's global role
item.description: The European Central Bank plans to expand currency safety nets to make it easier for foreign central banks to borrow euros, ECB President Christine Lagarde said on Monday, in a bid to strengthen the single currency's global standing.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The European Central Bank plans to expand currency safety nets to make it easier for foreign central banks to borrow euros, ECB President Christine Lagarde said on Monday, in a bid to strengthen the single currency's global standing. The [USN:L4N3ZA02V TEXT:"push"] comes amid concerns over financial fragmentation and [USN:L4N44P02A TEXT:"growing uncertainty"] around the future of the US dollar under President Donald Trump. Lagarde said the ECB would work on swap lines, which act as a source of emergency liquidity at times of crisis by allowing foreign central banks to borrow euros in exchange for their own currency. "We will be working on swap lines that will be more responsive to the imperative of having a sovereign euro area and a strong euro," Lagarde told European lawmakers. Swap lines relieve pressure on foreign borrowers but also prevent stress abroad from spilling over into the euro area. The ECB has such arrangements with the US Federal Reserve and the central banks of Japan, Britain, Canada and Switzerland. The move is part of an ongoing ECB effort to expand the euro's international footprint. The ECB [USN:L8N41L3LR TEXT:"has received"] nearly 30 applications for a separate lending facility - known as repurchase agreements or repo - that allows foreign banks to borrow against euro collateral. Central bank officials and investors worry that the US Federal Reserve might eventually cut its own [USN:L8N41Y0WB TEXT:"swap lines"], which currently serve as the main global lifeline for trillions of dollars in foreign loans.

item.title: Russland stellt Metros Vermögenswerte unter Zwangsverwaltung
item.description: Der russische Präsident Wladimir Putin hat die Vermögenswerte des deutschen Handelskonzerns Metro unter vorübergehende staatliche Verwaltung gestellt. Dies geht aus einem am Montag veröffentlichten Präsidialdekret hervor. "Der russische Staat hat die operative Kontrolle an UK Torg RUS übertragen, ein Unternehmen des CEO von METRO Russia, Johannes Tholey", teilte Metro mit. Die Entscheidung fällt in eine Phase verschärfter Spannungen zwischen Moskau und Berlin wegen des Ukraine-Kriegs.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Der russische Präsident Wladimir Putin hat die Vermögenswerte des deutschen Handelskonzerns Metro (B4B0n.H) unter vorübergehende staatliche Verwaltung gestellt. Dies geht aus einem am Montag veröffentlichten Präsidialdekret hervor. "Der russische Staat hat die operative Kontrolle an UK Torg RUS übertragen, ein Unternehmen des CEO von METRO Russia, Johannes Tholey", teilte Metro mit. Die Entscheidung fällt in eine Phase verschärfter Spannungen zwischen Moskau und Berlin wegen des Ukraine-Kriegs. Das Dekret nannte keine Gründe für den Schritt. Der seit 2001 in Russland engagierte Handelskonzern war anders als zahlreiche andere westliche Unternehmen nach dem russischen Überfall auf die Ukraine im Land geblieben. Metro tue dies aus Rücksicht auf Mitarbeiter und Kunden, hatte der Konzern immer wieder erklärt. Metro beschäftigt in Russland rund 9000 Menschen und betreibt 91 Märkte. Metro hatte dort in der Vergangenheit Milliardenumsätze eingefahren. Der russische Außenminister Sergej Lawrow und sein deutscher Amtskollege Johann Wadephul hatten sich am Wochenende am Rande der UN-Vollversammlung in New York zu Gesprächen über die Ukraine getroffen. Lawrow erklärte anschließend, er habe dabei keine neuen Erkenntnisse gewonnen. Deutschland wirft Russland einen versuchten Drohnenangriff auf den Flughafen Leipzig/Halle vor und hatte als Reaktion unter anderem die Schließung eines russischen Konsulats und eines Kulturzentrums in Berlin angeordnet. Moskau bestreitet die Vorwürfe. Die russische Metro-Tochter teilte am Montag mit, der Betrieb laufe normal weiter und alle Verpflichtungen gegenüber Kunden würden erfüllt. Russland hatte erst Anfang September die Kontrolle über die russischen Vermögenswerte des Schweizer Nahrungsmittelkonzerns Nestle (NESN.S) und des französischen Einzelhändlers Auchan übernommen. Zur Begründung hieß es von russischer Seite, feindselige Handlungen "unfreundlicher" Staaten hätten bei dieser Entscheidung eine Rolle gespielt.

item.title: Trabajadores de mina chilena Centinela de Antofagasta rechazan contrato; abren vía a huelga
item.description: Los trabajadores de dos sindicatos de la mina chilena de cobre Centinela, de Antofagasta Minerals, rechazaron el lunes una oferta de contrato colectivo presentada por la empresa, lo que allana el camino a una huelga en el yacimiento.
item.dc:creator: Fabián Andrés Cambero
item.content:encoded: Los trabajadores de dos sindicatos de la mina chilena de cobre Centinela, de Antofagasta Minerals, rechazaron el lunes una oferta de contrato colectivo presentada por la empresa, lo que allana el camino a una huelga en el yacimiento. Según la legislación chilena, al rechazarse la oferta las partes aún deben pasar por una intermediación gubernamental obligatoria de cinco días, que puede extenderse por igual período de mutuo acuerdo, antes de quedar autorizado el inicio de una huelga. La semana pasada, los sindicatos de Minera Esperanza y de Distrito Centinela -que unieron su negociación colectiva- recibieron la última propuesta del proceso formal de diálogo y llamaron a rechazarla. "Respondiendo el llamado de la dirigencia sindical, el 98,73% del total de socios votó por la huelga, habiendo participado en la votación el 100% de los socios habilitados", dijo el gremio en un comunicado. Las organizaciones se han quejado que la empresa no ha querido discutir sobre la igualdad en los beneficios de los trabajadores, independiente del sindicato al que pertenezcan. "La empresa se ha negado hasta el momento a abordar una solución sobre la materia, que garantice el derecho de igualdad de trato. En virtud de esta negativa, los sindicatos han preparado sus planes de contingencia de huelga, para sostenerla todo el tiempo que sea necesario", agregaron. Antofagasta Minerals declina comentar sobre sus negociaciones colectivas.

item.title: Anthropic, OpenAI will not attend Australian senate AI hearing on October 1
item.description: Anthropic will not appear before an Australian senate committee hearing on AI on October 1, a source familiar with the matter said, days after a disclosure that an agent from OpenAI gained unauthorized access to the country's health system database.
item.dc:creator: Anzar Mehraj
item.content:encoded: Anthropic will not appear before an Australian senate committee hearing on AI on October 1, a source familiar with the matter said, days after a disclosure that an agent from OpenAI gained unauthorized[USN:L4N45F1EW TEXT:" access"] to the country's health system database. The Claude-parent has sought another date, the person who declined to be named, said as the invitation came late last week. OpenAI too cited the same reason and said it could not arrange for its executives to appear in the short time frame. The senate inquiry is examining the potential impacts of AI and data centers on Australian communities, industries, water and energy. It is one of several state and federal probes into AI. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei were sent [USN:L4N45J005 TEXT:"written requests to appear"] before the senate inquiry in Canberra, after the Medicare hack. The disclosure could be the first known instance of an AI agent hacking a government website. Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese called the incident "unacceptable" and said he had raised "extreme concern" with Altman. OpenAI said it was following the committee's work and would remain in contact if further hearings were scheduled. Meanwhile, OpenAI's Chief Strategy Officer Jason Kwon will travel from the US to appear before a separate Joint Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence in Sydney on October 6, an OpenAI spokesperson said, adding that the company had lodged a submission to that inquiry.

FAST

Sept 28 : Egypt coach Hossam Hassan sought on Monday to calm speculation over Mohamed Salah's relationship with the national team after his omission from Tuesday's Africa Cup of Nations qualifier against South Sudan fuelled debate in local media. The issue has dominated discussions around the Egypt camp since the seven-times African champions were held to a 0-0 draw by Angola in their Group B opener, when Salah was substituted midway through the second half before leaving camp the next day. Speculation intensified after Hassan said the substitution was made for "technical reasons", despite Salah's strong form since joining Turkish side Trabzonspor from Liverpool. Local reports also linked the controversy to some of Hassan's previous comments about senior players, including goalkeeper Mohamed El Shenawy who he said "at one point was finished", prompting questions about the mood inside the squad.

However, Hassan struck a conciliatory tone ahead of the trip to Juba, underlining Salah's importance to Egypt's plans. "I respect all the players, especially Mohamed Salah. He is an important and influential player, one of the team's key pillars, a great player and a vital member of the team, as well as one of the best players in the world," he told reporters. The coach said 34-year-old Salah's absence against South Sudan had been agreed between them before the Angola match because of concerns over the artificial playing surface. "We decided to rest Salah because of the artificial pitch. He had discussed the matter with me before the Angola match, and we agreed on it," Hassan said. "We need Salah in the upcoming matches. The well-being of every player is my top priority, and I have great confidence in all the players," he added. Egypt are seeking their first victory of the qualifying campaign as they bid to reach the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations finals in Kenya, Uganda and Tanzania.

item.title: With Burry as adviser, a new short-focused fund takes aim at private credit risks
item.description: Wall Street is busy scouring AI stocks for signs of a bubble, but a new hedge fund tied to famed short seller Michael Burry is coming to the market eyeing more consequential warnings of rising froth elsewhere - in private credit loan books.
item.dc:creator: Johann Cherian, Niket Nishant
item.content:encoded: Wall Street is busy scouring AI stocks for signs of a bubble, but a new hedge fund tied to famed short seller Michael Burry is coming to the market eyeing more consequential warnings of rising froth elsewhere - in private credit loan books. Minerva Investment Management, a short-biased fund by Laks Ganapathi which has hired Burry [USN:L4N4580LJ TEXT:"as a senior adviser"], is scanning sectors spanning healthcare, retail, restaurants and smaller banks for short targets. Financing of many companies in these sectors are tied to private credit and they could be quietly rotting beneath the surface, Ganapathi said in an interview with Reuters. Short-biased funds structured as hedge funds mainly profit when stock prices decline. Ganapathi declined to name specific short targets and the size of the fund, which she said will be launched later this month. "AI is not the entire market, even though it appears to be," Ganapathi said. "For us, credit is the leading indicator and signal on how the market is going to be." The fund is targeting a potential blind spot as private credit's opacity can mask financial strain on borrowers for years, as highlighted in the bankruptcies of US auto parts supplier First Brands, car dealer Tricolor and UK mortgage provider Market Financial Solutions. "This time around, it is not going to be like 2008. It's going to be a lot worse," Ganapathi said. US private credit default rate reached an all-time high of 6.3% in August on an annualized basis, according to Fitch Ratings. TOUGH TERRAIN Minerva is entering an unforgiving corner of the hedge fund industry. Dedicated short-biased funds have dwindled to just six as of the second quarter of 2026 from 54 in 2008, according to HFR industry estimates. Much of it has been due to the increased regulatory scrutiny of short positions, a challenging performance environment for short exposures and changes in hedge fund reporting in the US. The 2021 [USN:L8N2K32JL TEXT:"Gamestop GME.N frenzy"] underscored the risks of crowded short bets as a stock's move disconnected from fundamentals can quickly overwhelm a sound investment case. Still, Ganapathi said Minerva could benefit from Burry's experience. His bets against the subprime mortgage market in 2008 were chronicled in "The Big Short". Burry wound down his hedge fund, Scion Asset Management, late last year, and launched a paid Substack newsletter, "Cassandra Unchained", which he uses to publish his market views. Ganapathi said someone close to Burry had first introduced them. She later reached out to Burry after he subscribed to her Substack newsletter, eventually asking him to join Minerva. Ganapathi is also the founder of Unicus Research, a short-selling research firm. Some of its top bearish recommendations were on electric vehicle maker Faraday Futures (FFAI.O) and used-car retailer Carvana (CVNA.N) , according to its website.

item.title: スペースＸの「スターシップ」、初の軌道到達 衛星26基展開
item.description:
Joey Roulette
[スターベース（米テキサス州） ２８日 ロイター] - 米実業家イーロン・マスク氏率いる宇宙開発企業スペースＸ
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Joey Roulette

[スターベース（米テキサス州） ２８日 ロイター] - 米実業家イーロン・マスク氏率いる宇宙開発企業スペースＸ の次世代ロケット「スターシップ」が２８日、米テキサス州から打ち上げられ、同社の打ち上げとして初めて地球の周回軌道に到達した。

飛行中にエンジン１基が予定より早く停止するトラブルが発生したものの、軌道に乗ることに成功。軌道到達後は、計画された高度約２６９キロ付近で衛星通信サービス「スターリンク」の次世代衛星２６基の展開を開始した。

スターシップはこれまでで最長となる約１０時間の飛行で地球を６周した後、南米チリ沖に着水する見通し。地球帰還を成功させられるかが今回の主要目標の一つとなる。

打ち上げに使用された第１段ブースター「スーパーヘビー」はメキシコ湾に帰還し、エンジン制御による着水を行った。

今回の飛行試験は１４回目。スペースＸが２０２３年以降に実施したこれまでの１３回の打ち上げはいずれも軌道到達に至らなかった。マスク氏は早ければ今年後半にも、スターシップの定期的な運用を開始したい考えを示している。

item.title: FBI deputy chief Bailey to resign after just over a year with agency
item.description: FBI Co-Deputy Director Andrew Bailey said on Monday he is resigning his position, leaving the most prominent US law enforcement agency after a little more than a year.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Goudsward
item.content:encoded: FBI Co-Deputy Director Andrew Bailey said on Monday he is resigning his position, leaving the most prominent US law enforcement agency after a little more than a year. Bailey, a Republican ally of President Donald Trump who [USN:L1N3UA0W1 TEXT:"left his job"] as Missouri attorney general to join the FBI, said he was leaving to return to his family. Bailey, serving under FBI Director Kash Patel, helped oversee election-related investigations and was present earlier this year when agents [USN:L1N3Z00SF TEXT:"seized"] 2020 election ballots from Georgia. "I am confident Director Patel will continue to reform the FBI, combat violent crime, defend the homeland, ensure strong organizational accountability, and restore public trust in this institution of excellence," Bailey wrote on social media. The deputy director's post, which oversees day-to-day law enforcement operations, has traditionally been apolitical and filled by career FBI officials. Trump has installed political allies in the role as he overhauls the agency to align with his agenda. Bailey initially served as co-deputy director alongside Dan Bongino, a former US Secret Service agent and conservative podcaster, who [USN:L6N3XN1EP TEXT:"left the FBI"] in January. Christopher Raia, a veteran FBI official, has more recently served as part of a three-person leadership team with Bailey and Patel. Bailey joined the FBI following a series of high-profile stumbles by Patel, including botched handling of investigative files on late sex offender and financier Jeffrey Epstein that caused [USN:L1N3TL13Z TEXT:"political headaches"] for the Trump administration and internal tension at the Justice Department. The latest high-profile departure at the FBI occurred about five weeks before the US midterm elections that will determine control of Congress. The Trump administration has [USN:L6N45F10R TEXT:"mobilized"] federal law enforcement agencies to investigate voting in elections by non-US citizens. Bailey during his tenure at the FBI has helped manage the Trump administration's investigations into election issues. The FBI has scrutinized election records from several states, but has not produced evidence to substantiate Trump's false claims that widespread voter fraud led to his electoral defeat in 2020.

item.title: 米30年債利回り04年以来の高水準、トランプ氏のイラン和平案拒否で原油高
item.description:
Sinéad Carew
[２８日 ロイター] - ２８日の米国債利回りは上昇し、３０年債利回りは一時、２００４年５月...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米30年債利回り04年以来の高水準、トランプ氏のイラン和平案拒否で原油高 9/28 23:49 配信

写真はドル紙幣。2023年3月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Sinéad Carew

[２８日　ロイター] - ２８日の米国債利回りは上昇し、３０年債利回りは一時、２００４年５月中旬以来の高水準を付けた。トランプ米大統領がイランの和平案を拒否したことを受けて原油価格が急伸し、インフレ長期化と米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による追加利上げへの警戒感が高まった。

１０年債利回りも一時、０７年６月中旬以来の高水準を付けた。３０年債利回り、１０年債利回りとも、その後上昇幅を縮小した。

トランプ氏が２６日、ホルムズ海峡を再開し中東での戦闘を終結させるとするイランの提案を拒否したと表明したことを背景に、米原油先物は約２％上昇。 これを受け、ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、市場が織り込むＦＲＢが１０月に２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の追加利上げを実施する確率は６８％と、２５日の６４％から上昇。１２月の追加利上げ観測も強まった。

ＬＰＬファイナンシャルのチーフ債券ストラテジスト、ローレンス・ギラム氏は「トランプ氏が中東停戦案を拒否したことで原油価格が再び上昇している。イランを巡る紛争の不確実性が残る限り、債券利回りには上昇圧力がかかり続ける公算が大きい」と指摘。「原油高は今後のインフレ指標に波及する。市場は今後１２カ月にわたるＦＲＢの利上げサイクルを織り込んでいる」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か コラム：米国債の「ベーシス取引」、軟着陸は可能か 焦点：債務膨張の先進国に金融危機の芽、最も懸念される米・伊・英 コラム：米財務省の借入拡大、債務問題の大きさに比べれば単なるノイズ コラム：米10年債利回り、利上げ局面でどこまで上昇　6％到達も視野 最終更新: 9/28(月) 23:49 ロイター

item.title: Lagarde del BCE se apega a estrategia de medidas graduales para frenar inflación
item.description: El repunte de la inflación de este año aún no ha generado efectos secundarios peligrosos en toda la zona del euro, por lo que sigue siendo adecuada una respuesta moderada por parte del Banco Central Europeo, dijo el lunes la presidenta del BCE, Christine Lagarde.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El repunte de la inflación de este año aún no ha generado efectos secundarios peligrosos en toda la zona del euro, por lo que sigue siendo adecuada una respuesta moderada por parte del Banco Central Europeo, dijo el lunes la presidenta del BCE, Christine Lagarde. La inflación de la zona del euro ya ha superado el 3% y podría acercarse al 4% a finales de año, el doble del objetivo del banco, lo que alimenta las apuestas del mercado a que serán necesarias hasta cuatro subidas de tasas más el próximo año, además de las dos ya aplicadas durante el verano boreal. Lagarde, sin embargo, pareció rebatir algunas de las previsiones más agresivas del mercado, argumentando que el alza de los precios del petróleo y el gas, derivada del conflicto entre Estados Unidos e Irán, es el principal factor que impulsa la subida de los precios. "Prevemos una mayor inflación en el futuro, pero aún no hay indicios de que se esté consolidando", dijo ante una comisión del Parlamento Europeo en Bruselas. "En este momento no vemos indicios de que los precios de la energía estén provocando un incremento de los salarios". "Esto significa que, aunque el impacto es demasiado grande como para ignorarlo, consideramos que una respuesta mesurada es la adecuada para mantener la inflación bajo control", añadió. Lagarde reconoció que los riesgos se inclinaban hacia una mayor inflación y que también existe el riesgo de que los gobiernos ofrecieran generosas ayudas para proteger a los consumidores frente al aumento de los costos energéticos. El apoyo fiscal se ha incrementado hasta situarse en torno a 0,1 puntos porcentuales del PIB de la zona del euro y las medidas han sido mucho menos temporales o específicas de lo que se esperaba, señaló Lagarde. El efecto conjunto de estas medidas tendrá un impacto de aproximadamente el 0,1% en la inflación, añadió. El problema es que, si bien los subsidios ayudan a reducir la inflación a corto plazo, a menudo la prolongan durante un período más largo y hacen aumentar el gasto fiscal, lo que provoca problemas más duraderos. Aunque Lagarde no detalló a qué se refería con una "respuesta mesurada", los economistas señalan que las dos primeras subidas de tasas, con tres meses de diferencia entre ellas, son una buena referencia. Por ello, muchos economistas prevén que el BCE mantenga las tasas estables en su reunión del 29 de octubre y las suba solo en diciembre, cuando se publiquen las nuevas previsiones. Estas opiniones se vieron reforzadas el lunes, cuando Lagarde reiteró su mensaje anterior de que las tasas de interés no evolucionarán al mismo ritmo que los costos energéticos. En cuanto a la economía, Lagarde se mostró optimista, argumentando que el sector manufacturero está registrando un comportamiento sólido, el mercado laboral se mantiene robusto y la inversión también debería respaldar el crecimiento.

Sep 28 (Field Level Media) - Cheryl Reeve of the Minnesota Lynx was named WNBA Coach of the Year for a record-extending fifth time on Monday. Reeve received 40 of 74 votes from a national panel of sportswriters and broadcasters after leading the Lynx to a league-best 33-11 record in the regular season. She previously won the award in 2011, 2016, 2020 and 2024. No one else has won the award more than three times since it was first handed out in 1997. Natalie Nakase of the Golden State Valkyries finished second with 20 votes and Sydney Johnson of the Washington Mystics was third with 14 votes. Reeve, 60, is 397-201 in 17 seasons as the head coach in Minnesota. She became the league's all-time leader in regular-season wins with her 380th victory on July 8 against the Connecticut Sun. Her top-seeded Lynx, pursuing their record fifth WNBA championship, trail 1-0 in their best-of-three, first-round playoff series against the New York Liberty. Game 2 is on Tuesday night in New York. (-Field Level Media)

item.title: Activos argentinos redoblan debilidad en inicio de semana por temor a recesión
item.description: Los mercados financieros de Argentina profundizaban su tendencia de debilidad el lunes por la firmeza del riesgo país y la retracción inversora ante datos flojos de la macroeconomía, que producen temor a una recesión.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los mercados financieros de Argentina profundizaban su tendencia de debilidad el lunes por la firmeza del riesgo país y la retracción inversora ante datos flojos de la macroeconomía, que producen temor a una recesión. El Gobierno reportó la semana pasada una fuerte caída en el [USN:ZON00GJPU TEXT:"consumo"] y un aumento en los niveles de [USN:S0N44F01B TEXT:"pobreza"], lo que alienta fantasmas de recesión a un año de las elecciones presidenciales. A esto se suma la suba gradual del dólar y la perspectiva de otra alza en las tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal de Estados Unidos (Fed), lo que conspira contra la liquidez de los mercados emergentes. El nivel del riesgo país se movía en los 641 puntos básicos (1600 GMT), un máximo en 10 meses, y el peso mayorista se depreciaba un 0,29 a 1.520 por dólar , tras anotar su piso récord intradiario en 1.535 unidades. "En la economía se confirma el clima recesivo: nuevos indicadores ilustran sobre la coyuntura con una caída en el consumo (...) y una medición de la pobreza alcista que confirmó las sensaciones negativas", sintetizó VatNet Financial Research. La bolsa de Buenos Aires cedía un 2,1% en el índice líder S&P Merval (.MERV) y arrastraba su sexta baja consecutiva, con un acumulado en torno al 8,5% con la salida de fondos de inversión. Este contexto impactaba sobre los bonos soberanos extrabursátiles con un pérdida del 0,2% en promedio, contra un derrumbe del 3,1% durante la semana previa. "La suba reciente del riesgo país y la presión observada sobre la curva de deuda soberana responden a una interacción de factores donde el frente internacional actúa como el principal disparador, combinándose en el plano doméstico con datos de actividad económica más débiles y un menor ritmo de compras netas de reservas", dijo Eric Ritondale, economista jefe de Puente. El gigante estadounidense J.P. Morgan redujo recientemente a 1,5% su proyección de crecimiento económico para Argentina este año, cuando la gestión del libertario Javier Milei proyectó un avance del 3%. El propio Milei descartó la proyección de una recesión durante una entrevista televisiva el domingo por la noche, aduciendo que hay datos estadísticos incorrectos. Mientras tanto, el Tesoro desarrollará durante el lunes una licitación de deuda en la que enfrenta vencimientos por unos 8,1 billones de pesos (unos 5.300 millones de dólares). El menú ofertado consiste en una letra "Lecap" corta (S13N6), una "Lecer" (X29E7), dos "Bontam" (TMF27 y TML27) y cuatro "dollar linked" (D30O6, D30N6, D31M7 y TZV27). Como sucedió en las dos licitaciones de agosto, el Tesoro no pone a disposición papeles con vencimiento en el próximo mandato presidencial, desde diciembre del 2027 en adelante.

item.title: India regulator allows Adani, four group firms to settle public-float violations case
item.description: India's market regulator on Monday allowed Adani Group Chairman Gautam Adani and four group companies to settle proceedings on alleged regulatory lapses related to a 25% minimum public shareholding requirement.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: India's market regulator on Monday allowed Adani Group Chairman Gautam Adani and four group companies to settle proceedings on alleged regulatory lapses related to a 25% minimum public shareholding requirement. The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) said four Adani companies and 14 company directors, including Gautam Adani, had settled the proceedings by paying a total of 14.82 million rupees ($154,403.15). In a separate order, the regulator said it has disposed of its case against the group claiming certain promoter holdings were categorised as public holdings. SEBI said it could not establish that investments made through two offshore funds and another public shareholder were directed by Vinod Adani, brother of Gautam Adani. Adani Group did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. In 2020, SEBI had received complaints against the group's flagship company Adani Enterprises, Adani Power, Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited and Adani Transmission — now known as Adani Energy Solutions — claiming they were not in compliance with its minimum public float rules. In its notices to the companies and Adani, the regulator had alleged violations of the public shareholding requirements and related shareholding disclosure rules. However, the settlement order does not require the companies to make any corrective shareholding disclosures, nor does it contain a regulatory finding on the alleged violations. The probe was part of the 24 investigations SEBI had undertaken after US-based short-seller Hindenburg alleged in 2023 that Adani group companies manipulated their stock prices through tax havens. Adani Group had denied the allegations. SEBI has since allowed the group [USN:L4N45E0QA TEXT:"to settle several"] cases in the last year, although probes are still pending into whether certain Adani Group offshore investors circumvented Indian rules and whether there was manipulation in the trading of the group's shares. The case disposed of on Monday centred on SEBI's investigations into whether offshore funds whose investments in Adani Group firms were funded largely through entities linked to two individuals — Nasser Ali Shaban Ahli and Chang Chung-Ling — were acting under the direction or control of Vinod Adani. The regulator's final order concluded there was insufficient evidence that Vinod Adani controlled investment decisions of the funds, including Emerging India Focus Funds and EM Resurgent Fund. However, SEBI fined Ahli and Ling 2 million rupees each for failing to furnish correct and complete information during the investigation. ($1 = 95.9825 Indian rupees)
